question: As of November 2026, who is the Chair of the U.S. Federal Reserve Board of Governors?
answer:
Kevin Warsh is the Fed Chair as of November 2026 [2][3]. CNBC's November 12, 2026 report refers to "Chairman Kevin Warsh" announcing changes to the FOMC meeting calendar [2], and a Bloomberg opinion piece dated November 11 calls him "Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh" [3].

CNBC's Jerome Powell profile page still lists him as chairman, but it notes his second term ended May 15, 2026 [1]. The page headlines also refer to Powell as "former Fed Chair" [1], so the profile's title appears to be out of date.
